name: Culture
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are called to live distinctly from the world, as Jesus reminds us that life transcends physical needs and that followers are chosen out of the world, which may cause opposition (Luke 12:23; John 15:19). Yet, God shows no partiality among people, welcoming those from different cultures who commit themselves to Him (Acts 10:34; Isaiah 56:6). The Bible also acknowledges the presence of diverse cultural settings, such as the Jewish synagogue in Thessalonica (Acts 17:1), and highlights the universal moral awareness God has placed in all hearts (Romans 2:15), encouraging respect for others while maintaining a Christ-centered identity.
